items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: An accordion is a list of questions that open one at a time: hairline rows, a bold question, a plus tile that turns into a cross.

items.name: activity-feed
items.title: Activity Feed
items.description: An activity feed is the record of who did what, newest first: a mark, one sentence and the time for each event, joined by a hairline.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An alert is a message that stays in the page until its cause is gone: a tray row with an icon tile, a title and a sentence.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: An alert dialog stops a person before something that cannot be undone, and makes them choose.

items.name: api-keys
items.title: API Keys
items.description: API keys lists the keys of a workspace with the secret masked, and shows a new key in full once, at the moment it is made.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: The app shell is the frame of a product: the sidebar on a tray at the start edge, the top bar over the content, and one centred column for the page.

items.name: article-01
items.title: Long read with contents
items.description: A long read: standfirst, byline, a wide lead picture, the contents at the side, prose with a pull quote and figures, then tags and share links.

items.name: article-02
items.title: Article with key facts
items.description: A how-to article beside an ink card of key facts: a callout, a table of how long a jar keeps, numbered notes and a note of what was updated.

items.name: article-03
items.title: The end of an article
items.description: Where an article ends: its last paragraphs, the author, the previous and next articles, comments with a reply, a comment form and three related ones.

items.name: articles-01
items.title: Journal
items.description: The front page of a journal: its name, topic tabs, one featured article, a grid of six more, pages, and a letter to sign up for.

items.name: articles-02
items.title: Search the articles
items.description: A search of the journal: the query typed, topics and a year to narrow it, the number of results, rows with the words marked, and Load more.

items.name: articles-03
items.title: Archive
items.description: Every article by month: tabs for the year, a row per article with its day, title and topic, and the topics and authors with their counts at the side.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Aspect ratio keeps a box in a fixed proportion while its width changes, so media never shifts the layout as it loads.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: An attachment is a file or an image that travels with a message: a small tray with a tile, a name and one line about it.

items.name: auth-form
items.title: Auth Form
items.description: The auth form is the card a person meets before the product: sign in or create an account. One column, one yellow button.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: An avatar stands for a person or a team: a softly squared tile with a photo or initials.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A badge is a short word or a number on a small chip: a status, a tag, a count.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: A banner is one line across the top of a page or a section, about the whole product or the whole account: a trial that is ending, planned maintenance, a payment that failed.

items.name: billing-summary
items.title: Billing Summary
items.description: The billing summary opens the billing page: the plan the workspace is on, what it costs and when it renews on an ink card, with the facts of the next invoice beside it.

items.name: blog-01
items.title: Blog home
items.description: A blog home: the latest posts with their date, author and tags, pages at the end, and an about card, the tags and a subscribe form at the side.

items.name: blog-02
items.title: Author page
items.description: One author's page: avatar, role, a short bio and links, three figures about their writing, their posts as cards with pages, and the other authors.

items.name: blog-03
items.title: Posts with a tag
items.description: One tag's page: tabs to switch tags, its posts by year in sections that fold, the current year open, and the season's figure and authors at the side.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A breadcrumb shows where a page sits and leads back up, one level per link.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: A bubble is the surface of a message: a soft block of fill around what was said.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A button starts an action; the yellow one is the single most important action in view.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: A button group is a tray that holds related buttons 4px apart, so they read as one control.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A calendar shows a month as a grid of days and takes one date or a range.

items.name: call-to-action
items.title: Call to Action
items.description: The call to action closes a page: one yellow card with the offer in a headline and the button that takes it.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A card is a tray: a grey surface with 40px corners that groups what belongs together. Fill alone sets it apart: no border, no shadow.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A carousel is one row of cards that scrolls sideways and snaps to each card, with previous and next buttons and a "2 / 5" count.

items.name: catalog-01
items.title: Catalog with filters on top
items.description: Products in a grid of cards under a filter bar for type, size and price, with the count, the sort and pages; for a range that three filters cover.

items.name: catalog-02
items.title: Catalog with a filter column
items.description: Products as rows beside a column of filters: checkboxes, a price limit and an in-stock switch. On a phone or a tablet the column opens from a button.

items.name: catalog-03
items.title: The range at a glance
items.description: The whole range on one page: a tile per category with its count, a table of jar sizes with the price of 10 g, and the three products ordered most.

items.name: changelog
items.title: Changelog
items.description: The changelog tells people what changed in the product: one entry per release, the date at the start edge, a title, a tag for the kind of change, and a short list.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox turns one option on or off; a group of them lets several be on at once.

items.name: checkout-01
items.title: Cart
items.description: The first step of a checkout, under a stepper: jars with a quantity, a meter to free delivery, a gift box with a note, a promo code and the summary.

items.name: checkout-02
items.title: One-page checkout
items.description: Contact, delivery with a day and a time slot, and the payment method on one page, beside the order summary.

items.name: checkout-03
items.title: Order placed
items.description: The page after paying: the order number, the delivery, what happens next, the summary, and where the jars come from.

items.name: checkout-summary
items.title: Checkout Summary
items.description: The checkout summary is the card beside a payment form: what is being bought, line by line, a place for a promo code, the total in the largest type, and the button that pays.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A code block sets code apart from prose: a tray in the mono face with a header that names it and copies it.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A collapsible shows and hides one block of detail under a short trigger, with a 44px plus tile that turns into a cross while open.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A combobox is a field that filters a list as you type and takes one of its options.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Command is a search field over a list of destinations and actions: type a few letters, press Enter.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A context menu opens where something is right-clicked and offers the actions for that thing.

items.name: cookie-consent
items.title: Cookie Consent
items.description: Cookie consent is a raised panel in the corner of the first visit: what is stored and why, and three equal ways to answer.

items.name: core
items.title: Tray UI core for React
items.description: What every Tray UI component in React needs: the helpers, the behaviours of the system as a module, the icons, and an import of the stylesheet from the package trayui.

items.name: dashboard-01
items.title: Dashboard
items.description: An app's home: a sidebar with a workspace switcher, four stat cards, a chart of orders per day and a table of the latest orders to select and sort.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: A data table is a Table that can be searched, sorted, selected and paged.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A date picker is a field that opens a calendar and shows the chosen date in words.

items.name: description-list
items.title: Description List
items.description: A description list sets out the facts about one thing as pairs: the name of the fact in soft ink at the start edge, its value beside it, a hairline between rows.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A dialog asks for one decision or one small task in a panel over the page, and holds the page still until it is done.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: Direction sets the reading direction of a region: with `dir="rtl"` every component inside mirrors, because the styles use logical properties throughout.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A drawer is a panel that rises from the bottom edge: the dialog of a phone.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A dropdown menu is a short list of actions that opens from a button.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: An empty state fills the place where content will be: an icon tile, a title, one sentence, and the action that makes the first item.

items.name: empty-01
items.title: First run
items.description: The orders page of a workspace on its first day: the first steps to take, a way to bring old orders, and the empty table where new ones will land.

items.name: empty-02
items.title: No results
items.description: A customer list whose search and filters match nobody: the filters stay in view, and the empty table names the near matches and clears the filters.

items.name: empty-03
items.title: No access
items.description: A packer opens the reports: a dimmed picture of what the page holds, who can open it, a way to ask for access, and the pages that are open to them.

items.name: feature-grid
items.title: Feature Grid
items.description: The feature grid tells what the product does in a few cards of unequal size: each one a small icon tile, a title, and two lines.

items.name: feedback-widget
items.title: Feedback Widget
items.description: The feedback widget asks one question with a row of numbers, then offers a box for the reason, then says thanks.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A field is one question in a form: a label, its control, and one line of help or error beneath. The control inside is linked to the label and the message by itself. The label is a `<label for>` the control; for a group of inputs, such as Input OTP, it is a span the group is named by (`aria-labelledby`).

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: File upload is a tray with a dashed edge that takes files dropped on it or chosen from the device, and lists them underneath.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter Bar
items.description: The filter bar sits over a list or a table: search at the start, filters as menus, sorting and the view at the end, and a chip for every filter that is on.

items.name: footer
items.title: Footer
items.description: The footer ends every public page: the name and a line about the product, the site's links in columns, and a last row for the legal lines.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: The hero is the first screen of a product's public page: what it is in one headline, one sentence, one yellow button, and something real to look at beside them.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A hover card previews what is behind a link when the pointer rests on it: a person, an order, a note.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: An icon in the colour of the text around it. The system's icons are Lucide's: the ones built in go by name, and any other comes from `react-icons/lu`.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: An input takes one line of text: a grey fill, 16px corners, 56px tall, no stroke. The fill follows the ground: white on a grey card.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: An input group is one field that also holds an icon, a unit, a prefix or one small button.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: Input OTP takes a short one-time code, one character per cell.

items.name: integration-card
items.title: Integration Card
items.description: An integration card stands for one outside service the product can work with: its mark, its name, what connecting it does, and the control that connects it.

items.name: invite-form
items.title: Invite Form
items.description: The invite form takes several emails at once, a role for all of them, and sends the invitations.

items.name: invoice-list
items.title: Invoice List
items.description: The invoice list is the table of past invoices: number, date, amount, whether it was paid, and a button to download each.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: An item is one row of a list: a media tile, a title with a line of detail, and something at the end.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Kbd shows a key of the keyboard as a small cap in the mono face.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A label names a control in plain words, above it, in `label` type. A Field draws its own label; use Label for a control outside a Field.

items.name: lib-account
items.title: lib-account
items.description: Shared code for account: the components that need it bring it.

items.name: lib-chat
items.title: lib-chat
items.description: Shared code for chat: the components that need it bring it.

items.name: lib-field
items.title: lib-field
items.description: Shared code for field: the components that need it bring it.

items.name: lib-forms
items.title: lib-forms
items.description: Shared code for forms: the components that need it bring it.

items.name: lib-nav
items.title: lib-nav
items.description: Shared code for nav: the components that need it bring it.

items.name: lib-overlays
items.title: lib-overlays
items.description: Shared code for overlays: the components that need it bring it.

items.name: lib-shell
items.title: lib-shell
items.description: Shared code for shell: the components that need it bring it.

items.name: lib-static
items.title: lib-static
items.description: Shared code for static: the components that need it bring it.

items.name: lightbox
items.title: Lightbox
items.description: A lightbox shows the pictures of a gallery one at a time, as large as the window allows, over the whole page.

items.name: login-01
items.title: Sign-in form
items.description: The plainest sign-in: a card centred on the page with email, a password you can show, a link for a forgotten one and six other accounts to use.

items.name: login-02
items.title: Sign-in page with a cover
items.description: The sign-in form in one half of the page, a cover in the other with a headline and a meter of the day's orders; for a sign-in that shows the product.

items.name: login-03
items.title: Sign-in page on a tray
items.description: A white sign-in panel on a grey ground, with Google and Apple shown and four more accounts in a menu, and the terms and privacy notice below.

items.name: login-04
items.title: Sign-in card with a picture
items.description: A wide card with the sign-in form beside a dark panel that follows one order, with the time of each step, from its arrival to the courier.

items.name: login-05
items.title: Email-only sign-in
items.description: Sign-in without a password: a link to the email that works for 15 minutes, six other accounts and a passkey; for a product that signs in by link.

items.name: login-06
items.title: Sign-in with social accounts
items.description: A sign-in card of six full-width account buttons and a link to use your email instead; for when most people use an account they already have.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A marker is a line in a conversation that is not a message: a date, a status, something the system did.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A menubar is the row of menus at the top of a working tool: File, Edit, View.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: A message is one row of a conversation: who spoke, what they said, and what happened to it.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: The message scroller is the window a conversation lives in: it keeps the newest message in view, and steps aside when the reader scrolls back.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: A native select is the browser's own menu in the system's field: the right choice on phones and in long forms.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: The navigation menu is the header of a site: the wordmark, a strip of links, and one small primary action.

items.name: notification-center
items.title: Notification Center
items.description: The notification centre is the panel behind the bell: what happened while you were away, newest first, unread ones marked and counted on the bell.

items.name: notification-preferences
items.title: Notification Preferences
items.description: Notification preferences is a grid of checkboxes: what can happen down the side, the ways to be told across the top.

items.name: onboarding-checklist
items.title: Onboarding Checklist
items.description: The onboarding checklist gets a new workspace to its first real result: a short list of tasks, the next one opened with its button, a bar that fills as they are done.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: The page header names the page: its title in `title` type, one line about it, the page's actions at the end edge, and tabs for its sections underneath.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Pagination moves through a long list one page at a time: 44px pages, the current one in solid ink, with Previous and Next on the resting fill.

items.name: payment-method
items.title: Payment Method
items.description: Payment method lists the cards on file as choices, marks the one that is charged, and takes a new card in three fields.

items.name: plan-comparison
items.title: Plan Comparison
items.description: The plan comparison is the full table under the pricing cards: every feature as a row, every plan as a column, a check, a dash or a number in each cell.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A popover is a small panel that opens beside the button that asked for it, for a few controls or a short explanation.

items.name: pricing-01
items.title: Plans at the end of a trial
items.description: Three plans side by side with a monthly or yearly switch, and what the trial used against the plan it fits.

items.name: pricing-02
items.title: Plans compared feature by feature
items.description: Every plan in one table, feature by feature in groups, with the price and a button at the head of each column.

items.name: pricing-03
items.title: Pricing by usage
items.description: One plan priced by the order: a slider that works out the month's price, what farms like yours pay, and questions that fold.

items.name: pricing-table
items.title: Pricing Table
items.description: The pricing table sets the plans side by side: a card each with the name, the price as the largest thing on it, who it is for, one button, and what is included. One plan is yellow.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A progress bar shows how much of a known whole is done: an 8px pill in `track`, filled in ink, with its name and value above.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: A questionnaire asks a few questions one at a time, when an assistant or a flow needs answers before it can go on.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A radio group picks exactly one option from a few that are all shown: plain radios for short lists, or choice cards for choices that need explaining.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Resizable splits a box into two panes with a handle between them that can be dragged, or moved with the arrow keys.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scroll area keeps a long list or a wide row inside a fixed box, with a thin scrollbar in the system's rule colour.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A select picks one option from a short list that opens under its trigger.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A separator is the one rule in the system: a 1px line in `hairline`.

items.name: settings-01
items.title: Profile settings
items.description: A personal profile in sections: a photo to upload, name and contact, language and time, and one bar that saves every change.

items.name: settings-02
items.title: Notifications by channel
items.description: Notification settings channel by channel: switches for email and the phone app, a phone number to add for text messages, and quiet hours for the night.

items.name: settings-03
items.title: Security and the danger zone
items.description: Two-step sign-in, the devices you are signed in on, and deleting the workspace behind a dialog that asks you to type its name.

items.name: settings-section
items.title: Settings Section
items.description: A settings section is one topic of a settings page: its name and a line of explanation in a narrow column at the start edge, its controls on a card beside it.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A sheet is a panel that slides in from the side and keeps the page in view beside it.

items.name: shop-01
items.title: Product page
items.description: A product page: pictures with thumbnails, the rating, sizes, the quantity, Add to cart, the delivery, tabs of details, reviews and four more products.

items.name: shop-02
items.title: Cart page with product lines
items.description: A cart inside the shop's header and footer: lines with a picture, quantity and Remove, the way to free delivery, three things to add and the summary.

items.name: shop-03
items.title: Cart in a sheet
items.description: Gifts on a page whose cart opens in a sheet at the side: lines with a quantity, the way to free delivery, the subtotal and Check out.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A sidebar is the navigation of an application: a tray down the side with groups of links, and the person's account at its foot.

items.name: sidebar-01
items.title: Sidebar grouped by section
items.description: The base app sidebar: a wordmark, main items with a count, two labelled sections and the user at the foot. Start here for one level of navigation.

items.name: sidebar-02
items.title: Sidebar with sections that fold
items.description: The base sidebar with labelled sections that fold under their headings, one open and one closed; for when there are many sections and people use few.

items.name: sidebar-03
items.title: Sidebar with a second level
items.description: A sidebar with a second level always open under its items, such as the statuses under Orders; for a short second level used every day.

items.name: sidebar-04
items.title: Sidebar with a level that folds
items.description: A sidebar whose items fold open to show their second level, Orders open and the rest closed; for when the second level is too long to keep open.

items.name: sidebar-05
items.title: Sidebar with menus
items.description: A sidebar whose items open their second level in a menu beside them, so the list stays short; for when people go straight to a page under an item.

items.name: sidebar-06
items.title: Sidebar that collapses to icons
items.description: A sidebar that a button in the top bar folds to a rail of icons with tooltips, with a workspace switcher, a meter of orders and an account menu.

items.name: sidebar-07
items.title: Inset sidebar
items.description: An inset sidebar on a grey ground, the page in one white panel: a workspace switcher, the main items, a list of recent batches and an account menu.

items.name: sidebar-08
items.title: Two sidebars
items.description: Two sidebars: a rail of section icons beside an inbox of messages with a search and an Unread switch; for when a section is a list to pick from.

items.name: sidebar-09
items.title: Sidebar with a file tree
items.description: A sidebar for files: the changed files marked as modified, added or deleted, then a tree of folders that fold, with the open file in the breadcrumb.

items.name: sidebar-10
items.title: Sidebar with a calendar
items.description: A wide sidebar for a calendar: a month to pick the day, your own and the shared calendars as checkboxes in groups that fold, and a button to add one.

items.name: sidebar-11
items.title: Sidebar at the end
items.description: A sidebar at the end of the page with the contents of a long guide: headings, sub-headings, the current place marked and a link back to the top.

items.name: sidebar-12
items.title: Sidebar on each side
items.description: Navigation at the start of the page and details at the end: one order's customer, items, total and next deliveries, with a button to pack it.

items.name: sidebar-13
items.title: Sidebar under a site header
items.description: A sidebar under a header that spans the whole product and holds the wordmark, the breadcrumb, a search, notifications and the account.

items.name: sidebar-14
items.title: Sidebar in a dialog
items.description: A settings dialog open over the app, with a sidebar of its own: six sections down the side and the notification switches of the chosen one.

items.name: sidebar-15
items.title: Navigation in a popover
items.description: A page with no sidebar: a Menu button in the header opens the navigation in a popover; for small products or pages that need the full width.

items.name: signup-01
items.title: Sign-up form
items.description: The plainest sign-up: a card centred on the page with work email, a password of at least 12 characters, six other accounts and a line on the terms.

items.name: signup-02
items.title: Sign-up page with a cover
items.description: The sign-up form in one half of the page and a cover in the other, listing three things a new account gets, from 14 free days to exporting your data.

items.name: signup-03
items.title: Sign-up page on a tray
items.description: A white sign-up panel on a grey ground, with Google and Apple shown and four more accounts in a menu, and the terms and privacy notice below.

items.name: signup-04
items.title: Sign-up card with a picture
items.description: A wide card with the sign-up form beside a panel of three first steps, from adding the products to packing the first order.

items.name: signup-05
items.title: Sign-up with sign-in providers
items.description: Sign-up that leads with six accounts, with the email and password right below on the same page; for when people should see both ways at once.

items.name: signup-06
items.title: Sign-up with social accounts
items.description: A sign-up card of six full-width account buttons and a link to use your email instead; for when the email form can live on a page of its own.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A skeleton holds the place of content that is loading, in the shape of what will arrive: a grey shape with a slow pulse.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A slider picks a number from a range by dragging, when the feel of the value matters more than its digits.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A spinner says that something is in progress and its length is unknown: an open ring in the text colour, always with words.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat Card
items.description: A stat card shows one number that matters: what it counts, the figure, how it moved, and optionally the line of its last weeks.

items.name: stats-01
items.title: Stat cards with a period switch
items.description: Six stat cards in two groups under a switch between 7 days, 30 days and the season, each set against the period before, the season against last year.

items.name: stats-02
items.title: Stat cards over a season chart
items.description: Stat cards and one large chart of the season on the ink card, with the harvest by bed and the goals of the season beneath.

items.name: stats-03
items.title: Breakdown by channel
items.description: A breakdown of the month: orders by channel beside the best sellers with their share, then orders by city and the share of repeat customers.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: A stepper shows where a person is in a short, fixed sequence: the steps as numbered marks over a bar that fills as they go.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A switch turns one setting on or off, and the change applies at once.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A table sets figures in rows and columns: hairline rows, quiet heads, numbers aligned on the right.

items.name: table-01
items.title: Table with filters and bulk actions
items.description: A table of batches in a card: a filter bar with search, two filters and a date range, rows to select with actions, a total and numbered pages.

items.name: table-02
items.title: Table with sortable columns and row menus
items.description: A table of customers with avatars, columns that sort, a search and a menu on each row, beside a sidebar folded to a rail.

items.name: table-03
items.title: Table with status tabs and a details sheet
items.description: Deliveries of the day in a table filtered by tabs with counts; each order opens its details in a sheet.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs switch between views of the same thing: a tray strip of 44px tabs, the current one in solid ink.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: A tag input takes several short values in one field: each becomes a chip that can be removed, and the caret waits after the last one.

items.name: team-members
items.title: Team Members
items.description: Team members is the table of people in a workspace: who they are, their role, whether they have joined, and when they were last seen.

items.name: testimonial
items.title: Testimonial
items.description: A testimonial is a customer's own sentence about the product, set large, with who said it underneath.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A textarea takes several lines of text, in the same fill and corners as an input.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A toast confirms that something just happened, in a small panel at the corner of the screen that leaves by itself.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A toggle is one button that stays pressed: on is solid ink, off is the resting fill.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A toggle group is the segmented control: a tray of segments where the selected one is solid ink.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A tooltip is one short line that names a control when the pointer or the keyboard is on it.

items.name: top-bar
items.title: Top Bar
items.description: The top bar is the row above the content: where you are at the start edge; search, notifications and the account at the end edge.

items.name: tour
items.title: Tour
items.description: A tour points at parts of a screen one at a time: a small raised panel beside the part, with a count, a sentence or two, and "Next".

items.name: trace
items.title: Trace
items.description: A trace shows what an agent did on the way to an answer: one line per step, with its state and how long it took.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: Typography sets text in one of the system's type styles: one grotesque, Onest, weight 700 with tight tracking for anything that names, weight 400 with open leading for anything that explains.

items.name: upgrade-prompt
items.title: Upgrade Prompt
items.description: An upgrade prompt stands where a feature would be when the plan does not have it: what the feature does, which plan has it, and one button to get it.

items.name: uptime
items.title: Uptime
items.description: Uptime shows whether a service is working now and how it did over the last 90 days: its state in words, a bar per day, and the share of time it was up.

items.name: usage-meter
items.title: Usage Meter
items.description: A usage meter shows how much of a plan's allowance is used: a Progress bar per limit with `role="meter"`, the numbers in words, and a note once a limit is near.

items.name: user-menu
items.title: User Menu
items.description: The user menu opens from the avatar at the end of the top bar: who is signed in, then the account's pages, the theme, help and signing out.

items.name: video-player
items.title: Video Player
items.description: A video player is a film with the system's controls under it: play, the place in the film, captions, sound and full screen.

items.name: wiki-01
items.title: Wiki page
items.description: A handbook page beside a tree of pages: who edited it last, an infobox, numbered steps, a callout, a table and a question on whether it helped.

items.name: wiki-02
items.title: Wiki home
items.description: A handbook's front page: a search, the sections as tiles with their page counts, recent changes, the most read pages and those due for a review.

items.name: wiki-03
items.title: Page history
items.description: The history of a handbook page: revisions with the date, author, summary and size of each, two ticked to compare, and the difference line by line.

items.name: workspace-switcher
items.title: Workspace Switcher
items.description: The workspace switcher is the button at the top of the sidebar that says which workspace you are in and opens the list of the others.
